data.gender_notes: Pranavraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Pranavraj is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Pranava' which means 'the vibration of Prana or life force'. In Hindu mythology, Pranav is considered the syllable 'Om', which represents the ultimate reality and the cosmic sound. The name Pranavraj is believed to bring blessings of wisdom, spiritual growth, and good fortune.

data.etymology: Pranavraj belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Vibration of Prana.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pranavraj total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

vedic_reference.note: Pranavraj is a modern name derived from the Sanskrit words 'Prana' meaning life force and 'Raja' meaning king. It is not directly mentioned in any Vedic scripture.

historical_references.reference: Pranavraj was a prominent Jain monk and scholar in the 12th century CE. He wrote commentaries on various Jain texts, including the Tattvarthasutra and the Samayasara. His works are known for their clarity and depth, and he is considered an authority on Jain philosophy.

Pranavraj is also mentioned in the 16th century CE Jain work 'Prabandhachintamani' by Acharya Hemchandra. In this text, Pranavraj is described as a great teacher and a master of Jain logic and rhetoric. He was a prominent figure in Jain monastic circles and is revered by Jains today.
